label: Quantity Selector
purpose: Let shoppers choose an order quantity, unlock volume-discount tiers (quantity breaks), and optionally add cross-sell upsell products
_notes:
This single block merges three real features, hence the large field count: (1) a classic quantity input, (2) up to 4 'quantity break' discount tiers (option_1..option_4), and (3) up to 3 cross-sell upsell slots (upsell_1..upsell_3). enable_quantity_discounts must be true for any of the option_N / upsell_N fields to matter. preselected picks which tier starts selected. pickers_label is the inline_richtext heading shown above per-tier variant pickers (only relevant if enable_variant_selectors is true). Upsells: leave upsell_N_product empty — no real product handle to reference, merchant assigns it later; upsell_N_min_offer is the tier at which that upsell becomes available; upsell_N_type is 'gift' (free), 'checkbox' (opt-in), or 'checkbox_preselected' (opt-in, pre-checked) — a real behavioral difference, not styling; upsell_N_text_left/text_right are inline_richtext (e.g. 'Add [title]' / '[price]'). Quantity tiers: option_N_quantity is the unit count for that tier (0 disables it); option_N_percentage_off_text / option_N_fixed_amount_off are the discount amounts as plain text (e.g. '10' or '5'); option_N_label/badge/benefit/caption/price_text/compare_price_text are all inline_richtext copy for that tier and support placeholders like [quantity], [price], [compare_price], [amount_saved]. All inline_richtext fields must NOT be wrapped in

tags. Excluded: the entire non_selected_*/selected_*/upsells_*_style_* two-tone color palette (~35 settings), style, update_pdp_prices, prices_layout, display_selected_indicator, border_radius/width, colors, color_scheme, accent_color, enable_variant_selectors_on_quantity_of_1, update_prices, show_selected_variant_images, variant_images_position, full_width_pickers, hide_pickers_overlay, indicator_top, scroll_media_gallery, image_width, vertical_items_align, space_images, vertical_images_position, hide_upsells_on_non_selected, upsells_image_size/text_size/badge_radius, option_N_compare_price (data-source, not copy), option_N_badge_style/color, option_N_benefit_position/style/radius/color, margins.
